title: K-drama Director
author: DefihunterD
selftext:
Inspired by my wife who loves watching K-drama series I have built a K-Drama simulation game. The game has the folowing elements:  
\- Trivia game which has content from 130 K-drama series. All has been translated for multiple languages  
\- Minigames to make this game more exiting  
\- Simulation: Hiring actors, staff, etc  
\- Multiplayer vs Ghost matches  
\- Realtime Multiplayer durig Live Ops for special Rewards 

https://reddit.com/link/1w7heu9/video/bs6i5ahziknh1/player

Techinal stuff:  
\- First started with Google Antigravitity, but switched to Codex around March  
\- No engine, this is a mobile game build with KMP framework. I choose something which has better performance than React Native . Further it has also multiplatform (IOS, Android) in mind  
\- Backend Supabase for multiplayer and content management.  
\- I had to refector the code many time and for the better architeture: scalabilty, testability, security, etc. With AI, I can create unit tests very fast!  
\- It started simple but the gameplay got complexer.   
\- I have build my own animation tool for spritesheets:  


Further I lost many time not just by building the game, but also testing even I made many unit, ui tests. And  i have made so many iterations, becuase i was not satisfied about the game mechanics. Did many research, now my audience. 

  
Will this game be a succes only time will tell. It is on Google
